label: Exact algebraic four-dimensional second-order subspace

algebraicDefinition.definingSystem: certificate.json: equations in the listed unknown-slot order with the listed fixed rational slots
algebraicDefinition.rootUniqueness: Unique zero in the displayed rational box, certified by a strict rational contraction
algebraicDefinition.equationConvention: Every listed rational quadratic polynomial equals zero. The coefficients are the unique real root in the product of the stated rational intervals. Fixed coordinates are exact rationals.

provenance.method: The supplied Julia parity-supported numerical subspace seeds a high-precision refinement. Twelve gauge coordinates are fixed to exact rationals; a rigorous rational contraction certificate proves existence and uniqueness of a zero of the resulting full 72-equation system. Equality to the original decimal span is not asserted.

basisConvention: Normalized Dicke states; the nth component is sqrt(binomial(20,n)) times the indicated complex polynomial coordinate.

verification.method: Exact rational fixed-point certificate and complete reconstruction of the 72 nonzero real compressed-moment equations.

optimality.bound: 4k <= N-2 at N=20 gives k<=4; the certified subspace attains it.

derivationLatex: z_{a,r}=a_{a,r}+i b_{a,r},\qquad(a_{a,r},b_{a,r})\in\mathbb R^2;\quad F(\mathbf x)=0,\quad\|\mathbf x-\mathbf x_0\|_\infty\le10^{-35}
parameterLatex: \mathbf x=(x_1,\ldots,x_{72})\in\mathbb R^{72};\qquad \text{12 remaining coordinates are fixed rationals.}
